pub struct OciPlugin {
    ovsdb_client: op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient,
}

impl Default for OciPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl OciPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            ovsdb_client: op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn reconcile_container_attachment(
        &self,
        container: &OciContainerConfig,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let attach = container
            .port_attach
            .clone()
            .with_context(|| format!("container '{}' has no port_attach", container.name))?;
        self.apply_attachment(&AttachmentActionConfig {
            container_name: container.name.clone(),
            loopback_required: container.loopback_required,
            port_attach: attach,
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn verify_container_attachment(
        &self,
        container: &OciContainerConfig,
    ) -> Result<bool> {
        let attach = container
            .port_attach
            .clone()
            .with_context(|| format!("container '{}' has no port_attach", container.name))?;
        self.verify_attachment(&AttachmentActionConfig {
            container_name: container.name.clone(),
            loopback_required: container.loopback_required,
            port_attach: attach,
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn delete_container_attachment(&self, container: &OciContainerConfig) -> Result<()> {
        let attach = container
            .port_attach
            .as_ref()
            .with_context(|| format!("container '{}' has no port_attach", container.name))?;
        self.ovsdb_client
            .delete_port(&attach.bridge, &attach.port_name)
            .await
    }

    fn state_from_value(value: &Value) -> Result<OciState> {
        if value.is_null() {
            return Ok(OciState::default());
        }
        simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(value.clone()).context("deserialize OCI state")
    }

    fn attachment_resource(container: &str, attach: &PortAttachConfig) -> String {
        format!(
            "{container}/port_attach/{}/{}",
            attach.bridge, attach.port_name
        )
    }

    fn already_exists(error: &anyhow::Error) -> bool {
        let text = format!("{error:#}").to_ascii_lowercase();
        text.contains("file exists") || text.contains("eexist") || text.contains("os error 17")
    }

    async fn interface_type(&self, port_name: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
        let operations = simd_json::json!([{
            "op": "select",
            "table": "Interface",
            "where": [["name", "==", port_name]],
            "columns": ["type"]
        }]);
        let response = self.ovsdb_client.transact_simd(operations).await?;
        Ok(response
            .as_array()
            .and_then(|entries| entries.first())
            .and_then(|entry| entry.get("rows"))
            .and_then(|rows| rows.as_array())
            .and_then(|rows| rows.first())
            .and_then(|row| row.get("type"))
            .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
            .map(str::to_string))
    }

    async fn ovs_attachment_ready(&self, attach: &PortAttachConfig) -> Result<bool> {
        let ports = self.ovsdb_client.list_bridge_ports(&attach.bridge).await?;
        if !ports.iter().any(|port| port == &attach.port_name) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        Ok(self.interface_type(&attach.port_name).await?.as_deref() == Some("internal"))
    }

    async fn ensure_ovs_attachment(&self, attach: &PortAttachConfig) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let mut changes = Vec::new();
        let ports = self.ovsdb_client.list_bridge_ports(&attach.bridge).await?;
        if !ports.iter().any(|port| port == &attach.port_name) {
            self.ovsdb_client
                .add_port_with_type(&attach.bridge, &attach.port_name, Some("internal"))
                .await
                .with_context(|| {
                    format!(
                        "create OVS internal port {} on {}",
                        attach.port_name, attach.bridge
                    )
                })?;
            changes.push(format!(
                "created OVS internal port {} on {}",
                attach.port_name, attach.bridge
            ));
        }
        if self.interface_type(&attach.port_name).await?.as_deref() != Some("internal") {
            self.ovsdb_client
                .set_interface_type(&attach.port_name, "internal")
                .await?;
            changes.push(format!("set {} type=internal", attach.port_name));
        }
        Ok(changes)
    }

    async fn namespace_attachment_ready(
        &self,
        pid: u32,
        loopback_required: bool,
        attach: &PortAttachConfig,
    ) -> Result<bool> {
        let port_name = attach.port_name.clone();
        let (interfaces, routes) = op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || {
            let port_name = port_name.clone();
            async move {
                let interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await?;
                let routes = op_network::rtnetlink::list_routes_for_interface(&port_name).await?;
                Ok((interfaces, routes))
            }
        })
        .await?;

        if loopback_required
            && !interfaces
                .iter()
                .any(|interface| interface.name == "lo" && interface.state == "up")
        {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let Some(interface) = interfaces
            .iter()
            .find(|interface| interface.name == attach.port_name)
        else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        if interface.state != "up" {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        for cidr in &attach.ip_addrs {
            let (address, prefix) = op_network::rtnetlink::parse_ipv4_cidr(cidr)?;
            if !interface.addresses.iter().any(|current| {
                current.family == "inet"
                    && current.address == address.to_string()
                    && current.prefix_len == prefix
            }) {
                return Ok(false);
            }
        }
        let route_matches = |destination: &str, gateway: Option<&str>, table: Option<u32>| {
            routes.iter().any(|route| {
                route.get("destination").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some(destination)
                    && route.get("gateway").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == gateway
                    && table.is_none_or(|expected| {
                        route.get("table").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) == Some(u64::from(expected))
                    })
            })
        };
        if !route_matches("0.0.0.0/0", Some(&attach.gateway), None) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        for route in &attach.routes {
            if !route_matches(&route.destination, route.gateway.as_deref(), route.table) {
                return Ok(false);
            }
        }
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn verify_attachment(&self, desired: &AttachmentActionConfig) -> Result<bool> {
        if !self.ovs_attachment_ready(&desired.port_attach).await? {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let pid = super::incus::IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&desired.container_name).await?;
        self.namespace_attachment_ready(pid, desired.loopback_required, &desired.port_attach)
            .await
    }

    async fn apply_attachment(&self, desired: &AttachmentActionConfig) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let initial_pid =
            super::incus::IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&desired.container_name).await?;
        let mut changes = Vec::new();
        if desired.loopback_required {
            op_network::rtnetlink::set_link_state_in_netns(initial_pid, "lo", true).await?;
        }
        changes.extend(self.ensure_ovs_attachment(&desired.port_attach).await?);

        let move_pid =
            super::incus::IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&desired.container_name).await?;
        if move_pid != initial_pid {
            anyhow::bail!(
                "Incus instance '{}' restarted during attachment (PID {} -> {}); retry",
                desired.container_name,
                initial_pid,
                move_pid
            );
        }

        let host_interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await?;
        if host_interfaces
            .iter()
            .any(|interface| interface.name == desired.port_attach.port_name)
        {
            op_network::rtnetlink::move_link_to_netns(&desired.port_attach.port_name, move_pid)
                .await?;
            changes.push(format!(
                "moved {} into {} netns PID {}",
                desired.port_attach.port_name, desired.container_name, move_pid
            ));
        }

        let configure_pid =
            super::incus::IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&desired.container_name).await?;
        if configure_pid != move_pid {
            anyhow::bail!(
                "Incus instance '{}' restarted after link move (PID {} -> {}); retry",
                desired.container_name,
                move_pid,
                configure_pid
            );
        }

        for cidr in &desired.port_attach.ip_addrs {
            let (address, prefix) = op_network::rtnetlink::parse_ipv4_cidr(cidr)?;
            if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_address_in_netns(
                configure_pid,
                &desired.port_attach.port_name,
                &address.to_string(),
                prefix,
            )
            .await
            {
                if !Self::already_exists(&error) {
                    return Err(error).with_context(|| format!("assign {cidr}"));
                }
            }
        }
        op_network::rtnetlink::set_link_state_in_netns(
            configure_pid,
            &desired.port_attach.port_name,
            true,
        )
        .await?;
        if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_default_route_in_netns(
            configure_pid,
            &desired.port_attach.port_name,
            &desired.port_attach.gateway,
        )
        .await
        {
            if !Self::already_exists(&error) {
                return Err(error).context("add namespace default route");
            }
        }
        for route in &desired.port_attach.routes {
            if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_route_in_netns(
                configure_pid,
                &route.destination,
                route.gateway.as_deref(),
                &desired.port_attach.port_name,
                route.table,
            )
            .await
            {
                if !Self::already_exists(&error) {
                    return Err(error)
                        .with_context(|| format!("add namespace route {}", route.destination));
                }
            }
        }

        if !self.verify_attachment(desired).await? {
            anyhow::bail!(
                "attachment verification failed for {}/{}",
                desired.container_name,
                desired.port_attach.port_name
            );
        }
        changes.push(format!(
            "verified {}/{} at current PID {}",
            desired.container_name, desired.port_attach.port_name, configure_pid
        ));
        Ok(changes)
    }
}

#[async_trait::async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for OciPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "oci"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "1.0.0"
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        std::path::Path::new("/var/lib/incus/unix.socket").exists()
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        "Incus Unix socket not available at /var/lib/incus/unix.socket".to_string()
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(oci_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let current = Self::state_from_value(current)?;
        let desired_state = Self::state_from_value(desired)?;
        let current_by_name: HashMap<&str, &OciContainerConfig> = current
            .containers
            .iter()
            .map(|container| (container.name.as_str(), container))
            .collect();
        let desired_by_name: HashMap<&str, &OciContainerConfig> = desired_state
            .containers
            .iter()
            .map(|container| (container.name.as_str(), container))
            .collect();
        let mut actions = Vec::new();

        for container in &desired_state.containers {
            let current_container = current_by_name.get(container.name.as_str()).copied();
            if let Some(attach) = &container.port_attach {
                let config = AttachmentActionConfig {
                    container_name: container.name.clone(),
                    loopback_required: container.loopback_required,
                    port_attach: attach.clone(),
                };
                let value = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(config)?;
                match current_container.and_then(|current| current.port_attach.as_ref()) {
                    None => actions.push(StateAction::Create {
                        resource: Self::attachment_resource(&container.name, attach),
                        config: value,
                    }),
                    Some(current_attach)
                        if current_attach != attach
                            || current_container.is_some_and(|current| {
                                current.loopback_required != container.loopback_required
                            }) =>
                    {
                        actions.push(StateAction::Modify {
                            resource: Self::attachment_resource(&container.name, attach),
                            changes: value,
                        });
                    }
                    Some(_) => {}
                }
            }
        }

        for container in &current.containers {
            if let Some(attach) = &container.port_attach {
                let desired_attach = desired_by_name
                    .get(container.name.as_str())
                    .and_then(|desired| desired.port_attach.as_ref());
                if desired_attach.is_none() {
                    actions.push(StateAction::Delete {
                        resource: Self::attachment_resource(&container.name, attach),
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        let current_value = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&current)?;
        let desired_value = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&desired_state)?;
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(&current_value)?)),
                desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(&desired_value)?)),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let mut changes_applied = Vec::new();
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        for action in &diff.actions {
            match action {
                StateAction::Create { config, .. } => {
                    let desired: AttachmentActionConfig =
                        simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(config.clone())?;
                    match self.apply_attachment(&desired).await {
                        Ok(changes) => changes_applied.extend(changes),
                        Err(error) => errors.push(format!("attachment create failed: {error:#}")),
                    }
                }
                StateAction::Modify { changes, .. } => {
                    let desired: AttachmentActionConfig =
                        simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(changes.clone())?;
                    match self.apply_attachment(&desired).await {
                        Ok(changes) => changes_applied.extend(changes),
                        Err(error) => errors.push(format!("attachment modify failed: {error:#}")),
                    }
                }
                StateAction::Delete { resource } => {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = resource.split('/').collect();
                    if parts.len() != 4 || parts[1] != "port_attach" {
                        errors.push(format!("invalid OCI attachment resource '{resource}'"));
                        continue;
                    }
                    match self.ovsdb_client.delete_port(parts[2], parts[3]).await {
                        Ok(()) => changes_applied.push(format!("deleted {resource}")),
                        Err(error) => errors.push(format!("delete {resource} failed: {error:#}")),
                    }
                }
                StateAction::NoOp { .. } => {}
            }
        }
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: errors.is_empty(),
            changes_applied,
            errors,
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let desired = Self::state_from_value(desired)?;
        for container in desired.containers {
            if let Some(attach) = container.port_attach {
                let config = AttachmentActionConfig {
                    container_name: container.name,
                    loopback_required: container.loopback_required,
                    port_attach: attach,
                };
                if !self.verify_attachment(&config).await? {
                    return Ok(false);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("OCI attachment rollback is not supported automatically")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn netmaker_state() -> Value {
        json!({
            "containers": [{
                "name": "netmaker",
                "loopback_required": true,
                "port_attach": {
                    "bridge": "ovsbr0",
                    "port_name": "netmk",
                    "ip_addrs": ["10.200.1.1/30"],
                    "gateway": "10.200.1.2",
                    "routes": []
                },
                "grpc_adapter": {
                    "binary": "op-grpc-adapters",
                    "socket": "/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker/op-grpc-adapters.sock",
                    "host_endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:50061"
                },
                "supervision": "runit"
            }]
        })
    }

    #[test]
    fn schema_uses_typed_port_name_attachment() {
        let schema = oci_schema();
        let containers = schema.fields.get("containers").unwrap();
        let FieldType::Array(container_type) = &containers.field_type else {
            panic!("containers must be an array");
        };
        let FieldType::Object(container_fields) = container_type.as_ref() else {
            panic!("containers must contain objects");
        };
        let port_attach = container_fields.get("port_attach").unwrap();
        let FieldType::Object(fields) = &port_attach.field_type else {
            panic!("port_attach must be typed");
        };
        assert!(fields.contains_key("port_name"));
        assert!(!fields.contains_key("iface_name"));
        let example = schema.example.unwrap().to_string();
        assert!(example.contains("netmk"));
        assert!(example.contains("127.0.0.1:50061"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn calculate_diff_creates_missing_attachment() {
        let plugin = OciPlugin::new();
        let diff = plugin
            .calculate_diff(&json!({"containers": []}), &netmaker_state())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(diff.actions.len(), 1);
        assert!(matches!(
            &diff.actions[0],
            StateAction::Create { resource, .. }
                if resource == "netmaker/port_attach/ovsbr0/netmk"
        ));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn calculate_diff_is_empty_for_equal_attachment() {
        let plugin = OciPlugin::new();
        let state = netmaker_state();
        let diff = plugin.calculate_diff(&state, &state).await.unwrap();
        assert!(diff.actions.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn additional_routes_are_typed() {
        let config: PortAttachConfig = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "bridge": "ovsbr0",
            "port_name": "netmk",
            "ip_addrs": ["10.200.1.1/30"],
            "gateway": "10.200.1.2",
            "routes": [{
                "destination": "10.44.0.0/16",
                "gateway": "10.200.1.2",
                "table": 254
            }]
        }))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config.routes[0].destination, "10.44.0.0/16");
        assert_eq!(config.routes[0].table, Some(254));
    }
}

pub(crate) fn rtnetlink_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let interface_fields = {
        let mut fields = HashMap::new();
        fields.insert(
            "name".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: true,
                description: "Interface name".to_string(),
                default: None,
                example: Some(json!("eth0")),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: true,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "netns_pid".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::Integer,
                required: false,
                description:
                    "Current container init PID whose network namespace owns the interface"
                        .to_string(),
                default: None,
                example: Some(json!(4242)),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "state".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::Enum(vec!["up".to_string(), "down".to_string()]),
                required: false,
                description: "Administrative interface state".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("up")),
                example: Some(json!("up")),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "addresses".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::Array(Box::new(FieldType::String)),
                required: false,
                description: "Interface IP addresses in CIDR form".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!([])),
                example: Some(json!(["10.0.0.2/24"])),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "mac_address".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "Optional MAC address override".to_string(),
                default: None,
                example: Some(json!("02:00:00:00:00:01")),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "default_gateway".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "Default gateway for this interface".to_string(),
                default: None,
                example: Some(json!("10.0.0.1")),
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields
    };

    let mut schema = PluginSchema::builder("rtnetlink")
        .category("network")
        .version("1.0.0")
        .description("Native kernel rtnetlink interface management")
        .array_field(
            "interfaces",
            FieldType::Object(interface_fields),
            true,
            "Desired rtnetlink-managed interfaces",
        )
        .example(json!({
            "interfaces": [
                {
                    "name": "ovsbr0",
                    "state": "up",
                    "addresses": ["10.10.0.1/24"],
                    "default_gateway": "10.10.0.254"
                }
            ]
        }))
        .build();

    schema.methods.insert(
        "move_link".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            MoveLinkInput,
            RtnetlinkMutationOutput,
        >(
            "move_link",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.network.rtnetlink.link.move-netns@v1",
            "mut.network.rtnetlink.link.move-netns@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "set_link_state".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<

//! Native, bounded building blocks for the inactive netmk Phase 1 runit graph.
//!
//! This binary never activates services. It owns only the declared netmk
//! attachment, feature policy rules/route, feature-cookie flows, and
//! authenticated adapter checks.

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use op_grpc_bridge::grpc_client::DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR;
use op_grpc_bridge::{GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::IncusPlugin;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::oci::{
    GrpcAdapterConfig, OciContainerConfig, OciPlugin, PortAttachConfig,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::openflow::{FlowAction, FlowEntry, OpenFlowPlugin};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::process::Command;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

const COOKIE_PREFIX: u64 = 0x4e4d4b0000000000;
const COOKIE_MASK: u64 = 0xffffff0000000000;
const BRIDGE: &str = "ovsbr0";
const PORT: &str = "netmk";
const HOST_INSIDE: &str = "svc0";
const XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS: &str = "10.200.0.1";
const XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS: &str = "10.200.1.2";
const FEATURE_SOURCE: &str = "10.200.1.1";

fn env_or(name: &str, default: &str) -> String {
    std::env::var(name).unwrap_or_else(|_| default.to_string())
}

fn is_already_exists(error: &anyhow::Error) -> bool {
    let text = format!("{error:#}").to_ascii_lowercase();
    text.contains("file exists") || text.contains("eexist") || text.contains("os error 17")
}

fn netmaker_attachment() -> OciContainerConfig {
    OciContainerConfig {
        name: env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker"),
        loopback_required: true,
        port_attach: Some(PortAttachConfig {
            bridge: BRIDGE.to_string(),
            port_name: PORT.to_string(),
            ip_addrs: vec![format!("{FEATURE_SOURCE}/30")],
            gateway: XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS.to_string(),
            routes: Vec::new(),
        }),
        grpc_adapter: Some(GrpcAdapterConfig {
            binary: "op-grpc-adapters".to_string(),
            socket: "/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker/op-grpc-adapters.sock".to_string(),
            host_endpoint: DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR.to_string(),
        }),
        supervision: Some("runit".to_string()),
        ..OciContainerConfig::default()
    }
}

async fn attachment(command: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let plugin = OciPlugin::new();
    let desired = netmaker_attachment();
    match command {
        "reconcile" => {
            for change in plugin.reconcile_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                println!("{change}");
            }
            if !plugin.verify_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                bail!("netmaker attachment did not pass independent verification");
            }
        }
        "verify" => {
            if !plugin.verify_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                bail!("netmaker attachment is not ready");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => plugin.delete_container_attachment(&desired).await?,
        other => bail!("unknown attachment action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn discover_xray_inside(pid: u32) -> Result<String> {
    let interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, || async {
        op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await
    })
    .await?;
    interfaces
        .into_iter()
        .find(|interface| {
            interface.name != "lo"
                && interface.addresses.iter().any(|address| {
                    address.family == "inet" && address.address == XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS
                })
        })
        .map(|interface| interface.name)
        .with_context(|| {
            format!(
                "no xray inside interface carries required existing address {XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS}"
            )
        })
}

async fn host_return_route_ready() -> Result<bool> {
    let routes = op_network::rtnetlink::list_routes_for_interface(HOST_INSIDE).await?;
    Ok(routes.iter().any(|route| {
        route.get("destination").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) == Some("10.200.1.0/30")
            && route.get("gateway").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) == Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS)
            && route.get("table").and_then(|value| value.as_u64()) == Some(254)
    }))
}

async fn egress_network_ready() -> Result<bool> {
    let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
    let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
    let interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await
    })
    .await?;
    let address_ready = interfaces.iter().any(|interface| {
        interface.name == inside
            && interface.addresses.iter().any(|address| {
                address.family == "inet"
                    && address.address == XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS
                    && address.prefix_len == 30
            })
    });
    Ok(address_ready
        && host_return_route_ready().await?
        && op_network::rtnetlink::verify_netmk_policy_rules().await?)
}

async fn egress_network(command: &str) -> Result<()> {
    match command {
        "reconcile" => {
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let initial_pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(initial_pid).await?;
            if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_address_in_netns(
                initial_pid,
                &inside,
                XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS,
                30,
            )
            .await
            {
                if !is_already_exists(&error) {
                    return Err(error).context("add xray netmk gateway address");
                }
            }
            let current_pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            if current_pid != initial_pid {
                bail!(
                    "xray restarted during reconciliation (PID {initial_pid} -> {current_pid}); retry"
                );
            }
            if !host_return_route_ready().await? {
                if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_route(
                    "10.200.1.0/30",
                    Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS),
                    HOST_INSIDE,
                    Some(254),
                )
                .await
                {
                    if !is_already_exists(&error) {
                        return Err(error).context("add feature host return route");
                    }
                }
            }
            op_network::rtnetlink::reconcile_netmk_policy_rules().await?;
            if !egress_network_ready().await? {
                bail!("native xray/host route and policy-rule verification failed");
            }
            println!("xray_inside={inside}");
            println!("xray_pid={current_pid}");
        }
        "inspect" => {
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
            println!("xray_inside={inside}");
            println!("xray_pid={pid}");
        }
        "verify" => {
            if !egress_network_ready().await? {
                bail!("native xray/host egress integration is not ready");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => {
            op_network::rtnetlink::delete_netmk_policy_rules().await?;
            op_network::rtnetlink::delete_ipv4_route(
                "10.200.1.0/30",
                Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS),
                HOST_INSIDE,
                Some(254),
            )
            .await?;
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
            op_network::rtnetlink::del_ipv4_address_in_netns(pid, &inside, XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS, 30)
                .await?;
        }
        other => bail!("unknown egress-network action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_ports(values: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
    if values.is_empty() {
        bail!("at least one approved UDP destination port is required");
    }
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    let mut ports = Vec::new();
    for value in values {
        let port: u16 = value
            .parse()
            .with_context(|| format!("invalid UDP destination port '{value}'"))?;
        if port == 0 {
            bail!("UDP destination port must be between 1 and 65535");
        }
        if seen.insert(port) {
            ports.push(port);
        }
    }
    ports.sort_unstable();
    Ok(ports)
}

fn desired_flows(ports: &[u16]) -> Vec<FlowEntry> {
    let mut flows = vec![FlowEntry {
        table: 0,
        priority: 100,
        match_fields: HashMap::from([
            ("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string()),
            ("arp".to_string(), String::new()),
        ]),
        actions: vec![FlowAction::Normal],
        cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0x01),
        idle_timeout: 0,
        hard_timeout: 0,
    }];
    for port in ports {
        flows.push(FlowEntry {
            table: 0,
            priority: 100,
            match_fields: HashMap::from([
                ("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string()),
                ("udp".to_string(), String::new()),
                ("tp_dst".to_string(), port.to_string()),
            ]),
            actions: vec![FlowAction::Normal],
            cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0x10000 | u64::from(*port)),
            idle_timeout: 0,
            hard_timeout: 0,
        });
    }
    flows.push(FlowEntry {
        table: 0,
        priority: 50,
        match_fields: HashMap::from([("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string())]),
        actions: vec![FlowAction::Drop],
        cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0xff),
        idle_timeout: 0,
        hard_timeout: 0,
    });
    flows
}

async fn openflow(command: &str, port_args: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
    let plugin = OpenFlowPlugin::new();
    match command {
        "reconcile" | "verify" => {
            let ports = parse_ports(port_args)?;
            let desired = desired_flows(&ports);
            if command == "reconcile" {
                for change in plugin
                    .reconcile_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, &desired, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                    .await?
                {
                    println!("{change}");
                }
            }
            if !plugin
                .verify_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, &desired, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                .await?
            {
                bail!("authoritative feature-cookie OpenFlow verification failed");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => {
            let deleted = plugin
                .clear_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                .await?;
            println!("deleted_flows={deleted}");
        }
        other => bail!("unknown openflow action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn adapter_client() -> RemoteOperationClient {
    let endpoint = env_or("NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR", DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR);
    RemoteOperationClient::new_with_netmaker_address(
        Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new()),
        "http://127.0.0.1:8090",
        &endpoint,
        "op-netmk-reconcile",
    )
}

async fn adapter_health() -> Result<()> {
    let health = adapter_client().netmaker_health().await?;
    let status = health.status.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if !matches!(status.as_str(), "ok" | "healthy" | "running" | "success") {
        bail!(
            "Netmaker adapter returned unhealthy status {:?}",
            health.status
        );
    }
    println!("status={}", health.status);
    println!("version={}", health.version);
    Ok(())
}

fn endpoint_port(value: &str) -> Result<Option<u16>> {
    if value == "(none)" {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let port_text = value
        .rsplit_once(':')
        .map(|(_, port)| port)
        .with_context(|| format!("WireGuard endpoint has no port: {value}"))?;
    let port: u16 = port_text
        .parse()
        .with_context(|| format!("invalid WireGuard endpoint port '{port_text}'"))?;
    if port == 0 {
        bail!("WireGuard endpoint port must be non-zero");
    }
    Ok(Some(port))
}

async fn discover_netclient_ports() -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
    let name = env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&name).await?;
    op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        let mut ports = HashSet::new();
        for query in [["show", "all", "listen-port"], ["show", "all", "endpoints"]] {
            let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/wg")
                .args(query)
                .output()
                .with_context(|| format!("execute /usr/bin/wg {}", query.join(" ")))?;
            if !output.status.success() {
                bail!(
                    "wg {} failed: {}",
                    query.join(" "),
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
                );
            }
            for line in String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).lines() {
                let Some(value) = line.split_whitespace().last() else {
                    continue;
                };
                let port = if query[2] == "listen-port" {
                    let port: u16 = value
                        .parse()
                        .with_context(|| format!("invalid WireGuard listen port '{value}'"))?;
                    if port == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    port
                } else {
                    let Some(port) = endpoint_port(value)? else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    port
                };
                ports.insert(port);
            }
        }
        let mut ports: Vec<_> = ports.into_iter().collect();
        ports.sort_unstable();
        if ports.is_empty() {
            bail!("no Netclient WireGuard listen or peer endpoint ports discovered");
        }
        Ok(ports)
    })
    .await
}

async fn recent_netclient_handshake(max_age_seconds: u64) -> Result<bool> {
    let name = env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&name).await?;
    op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/wg")
            .args(["show", "all", "latest-handshakes"])
            .output()
            .context("execute /usr/bin/wg in netmaker network namespace")?;
        if !output.status.success() {
            bail!(
                "wg show failed: {}",
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
            );
        }
        let now = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .context("system clock before UNIX epoch")?
            .as_secs();
        for line in String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).lines() {
            let timestamp = line
                .split_whitespace()
                .last()
                .and_then(|value| value.parse::<u64>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            if timestamp > 0 && now.saturating_sub(timestamp) <= max_age_seconds {
                return Ok(true);
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    })
    .await
}

/// High-level client for remote Operation services
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub struct RemoteOperationClient {
    pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>,
    default_address: String,
    netmaker_address: String,
    client_id: String,
}

impl RemoteOperationClient {
    /// Backward-compatible constructor: both service families use `address`.
    pub fn new(pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>, address: &str, client_id: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            pool,
            default_address: address.to_string(),
            netmaker_address: address.to_string(),
            client_id: client_id.to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// Construct a client with an explicit dedicated Netmaker adapter endpoint.
    pub fn new_with_netmaker_address(
        pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>,
        address: &str,
        netmaker_address: &str,
        client_id: &str,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            pool,
            default_address: address.to_string(),
            netmaker_address: netmaker_address.to_string(),
            client_id: client_id.to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// Construct a client using `NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR`, defaulting to the
    /// fixed host bridge at `http://127.0.0.1:50061`.
    pub fn new_with_netmaker_env(
        pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>,
        address: &str,
        client_id: &str,
    ) -> Self {
        let netmaker_address = std::env::var("NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR.to_string());
        Self::new_with_netmaker_address(pool, address, &netmaker_address, client_id)
    }

    /// Override the dedicated Netmaker endpoint in builder style.
    pub fn with_netmaker_address(mut self, address: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.netmaker_address = address.into();
        self
    }

    /// Get state from a remote endpoint
    pub async fn get_state(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(GetStateRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
        });
        attach_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request)?;

        let response = client
            .get_state(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        let state = resp.state.unwrap_or_default();
        Ok(prost_struct_to_simd(&state))
    }

    /// Set state on a remote endpoint (apply patch)
    pub async fn set_state(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        state: simd_json::OwnedValue,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<SetStateResult, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(MutateRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            operation: ProtoOperationType::ApplyPatch as i32,
            member_name: String::new(),
            value: Some(simd_to_prost_value(&state)),
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
            idempotency_key: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        });
        attach_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request)?;

        let response = client
            .mutate(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "mutation failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        Ok(SetStateResult {
            event_id: resp.event_id,
            effective_hash: resp.effective_hash,
        })
    }

    /// Call a method on a remote endpoint
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn call_method(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        interface_name: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self
            .pool
            .plugin_service_client(&self.default_address)
            .await?;

        let arguments = arguments
            .iter()
            .map(simd_to_prost_value)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();

        let mut request = Request::new(CallMethodRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            interface_name: interface_name.to_string(),
            method_name: method_name.to_string(),
            arguments,
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
        });
        attach_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request)?;

        let response = client
            .call_method(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "call failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        if let Some(result) = resp.result {
            Ok(prost_value_to_simd(&result))
        } else {
            Ok(simd_json::json!(null))
        }
    }

    /// Call a method while preserving the Ghostbridge identity supplied by an
    /// outer transport adapter. This keeps HTTP on op-web while capability
    /// enforcement remains in the bridge's canonical gRPC method pipeline.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn call_method_with_metadata(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        interface_name: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self
            .pool
            .plugin_service_client(&self.default_address)
            .await?;

        let arguments = arguments
            .iter()
            .map(simd_to_prost_value)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();

        let mut request = Request::new(CallMethodRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            interface_name: interface_name.to_string(),
            method_name: method_name.to_string(),
            arguments,
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
        });
        attach_supplied_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request, identity)?;

        let response = client
            .call_method(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "call failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        if let Some(result) = resp.result {
            Ok(prost_value_to_simd(&result))
        } else {
            Ok(simd_json::json!(null))
        }
    }

    /// Subscribe to state updates from a remote endpoint
    pub async fn subscribe(
        &self,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        path_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<StateUpdateMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(SubscribeRequest {
            plugin_ids: plugin_filters,
            path_patterns: path_filters,
            tags: tag_filters,
            include_initial_state: false,
        });
        attach_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request)?;

        let response = client
            .subscribe(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let stream = response.into_inner();

        Ok(tokio_stream::StreamExt::map(stream, |result| {
            result
                .map(|update| StateUpdateMessage {
                    plugin_id: update.plugin_id,
                    object_path: update.object_path,
                    property_name: if update.member_name.is_empty() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(update.member_name)
                    },
                    new_value: update.new_value.as_ref().map(prost_value_to_simd),
                    event_id: update.event_id.to_string(),
                    tags_touched: update.tags_touched,
                })
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::StreamError(e.to_string()))
        }))
    }

    /// Subscribe to chain events from a remote endpoint
    pub async fn stream_events(
        &self,
        from_event_id: Option<u64>,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<ChainEventMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        let mut client = self.pool.event_chain_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(SubscribeEventsRequest {
            from_event_id: from_event_id.unwrap_or_default(),
            plugin_id: plugin_filters.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
            tags: tag_filters,
        });
        attach_ghostbridge_metadata(&mut request)?;

        let response = client
            .subscribe_events(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let stream = response.into_inner();

        Ok(tokio_stream::StreamExt::map(stream, |result| {
            result
                .map(|event| ChainEventMessage {
                    event_id: event.event_id.to_string(),
                    event_hash: event.event_hash,
                    prev_hash: event.prev_hash,
                    plugin_id: event.plugin_id,
                    operation_type: event.operation_type,
                    target: event.target,
                    decision: event.decision.to_string(),
                    tags_touched: event.tags_touched,
                })
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::StreamError(e.to_string()))
        }))
    }
}

/// Result of a set state operation
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SetStateResult {
    pub event_id: u64,
    pub effective_hash: String,
}

/// State update message from subscription
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct StateUpdateMessage {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub property_name: Option<String>,
    pub new_value: Option<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
    pub event_id: String,
    pub tags_touched: Vec<String>,
}

/// Chain event message from event stream
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ChainEventMessage {
    pub event_id: String,
    pub event_hash: String,
    pub prev_hash: String,
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub operation_type: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub decision: String,
    pub tags_touched: Vec<String>,
}

/// Errors that can occur in gRPC client operations
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum GrpcClientError {
    ConnectionFailed(String),
    RequestFailed(String),
    StreamError(String),
    ParseError(String),
    RemoteError { code: String, message: String },
}

impl std::fmt::Display for GrpcClientError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::ConnectionFailed(msg) => write!(f, "Connection failed: {}", msg),
            Self::RequestFailed(msg) => write!(f, "Request failed: {}", msg),
            Self::StreamError(msg) => write!(f, "Stream error: {}", msg),
            Self::ParseError(msg) => write!(f, "Parse error: {}", msg),
            Self::RemoteError { code, message } => {
                write!(f, "Remote error [{}]: {}", code, message)
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for GrpcClientError {}

fn attach_ghostbridge_metadata<T>(request: &mut Request<T>) -> Result<(), GrpcClientError> {
    let (sled_ptr, _mmap) = op_identity::read_sled()
        .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("Identity Sled unreadable: {e}")))?;
    let sled = unsafe { &*sled_ptr };

    if !sled.is_sled_valid() {
        return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
            "Identity Sled is invalid; refusing unauthenticated gRPC call".to_string(),
        ));
    }

    let footprint = hex::encode(sled.hashed_footprint);
    let trace_id = sled.trace_id_hex();
    let metadata = request.metadata_mut();
    metadata.insert(
        "x-ghostbridge-footprint",
        MetadataValue::try_from(footprint).map_err(|e| {
            GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("Invalid footprint metadata: {e}"))
        })?,

<content>
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
exec 2>&1

OLD_NAME=${OLD_NAME:-NetMaker}
NEW_NAME=${NEW_NAME:-netmaker}
GOLDEN=${OPDBUS_GOLDEN:-/opt/op-dbus/golden}
BASELINE_DIR=${NETMAKER_BASELINE_DIR:?set NETMAKER_BASELINE_DIR to the captured 0700 baseline}
RUNTIME_DIR=/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker
ENV_OUT=/etc/default/opdbus-netmk
ADDR=unix:path=/run/opdbus/session-bus.sock
BUS_NAME=org.opdbus.v1.plugins
OBJECT=/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus
INTERFACE=org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1
SOCKET=/var/lib/incus/unix.socket
SNAPSHOT=${NETMAKER_SNAPSHOT:-pre-runit-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}
MUTATED=0
RENAMED=0
SUCCESS=0

log() { printf '[netmaker-runit-migrate] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

state() {
    name=$1
    /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCKET" \
        "http://localhost/1.0/instances/$name/state" 2>/dev/null |
        /usr/bin/jq -r '.metadata.status // "Missing"' 2>/dev/null || printf 'Missing\n'
}

pid_of() {
    name=$1
    /usr/bin/curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCKET" \
        "http://localhost/1.0/instances/$name/state" |
        /usr/bin/jq -r '.metadata.pid // 0'
}

call_incus() {
    method=$1
    payload=$2
    /usr/bin/busctl --address="$ADDR" call "$BUS_NAME" "$OBJECT" "$INTERFACE" \
        Call ss "$method" "$payload" >/dev/null
}

payload() {
    /usr/bin/jq -cn "$@"
}

set_config() {
    name=$1 key=$2 value=$3
    call_incus set_instance_config "$(payload --arg name "$name" --arg key "$key" --arg value "$value" \
        '{name:$name,key:$key,value:$value}')"
}

unset_config() {
    name=$1 key=$2
    call_incus set_instance_config "$(payload --arg name "$name" --arg key "$key" \
        '{name:$name,key:$key,value:null}')"
}

add_disk() {
    name=$1 device_name=$2 source=$3 target=$4 readonly=$5 shift=$6
    call_incus add_device "$(payload \
        --arg instance "$name" --arg device "$device_name" \
        --arg source "$source" --arg path "$target" \
        --argjson readonly "$readonly" --argjson shift "$shift" \
        '{instance_name:$instance,device_name:$device,device:{type:"disk",source:$source,path:$path,readonly:$readonly,required:true,shift:$shift}}')"
}

remove_device() {
    name=$1 device_name=$2
    call_incus remove_device "$(payload --arg instance "$name" --arg device "$device_name" \
        '{instance_name:$instance,device_name:$device}')" || true
}

wait_state() {
    name=$1 expected=$2 limit=$3
    waited=0
    while [ "$(state "$name")" != "$expected" ]; do
        [ "$waited" -lt "$limit" ] || return 1
        sleep 1
        waited=$((waited + 1))
    done
}

rollback() {
    [ "$MUTATED" -eq 1 ] || return 0
    log 'rolling back container identity, init, and feature devices'
    current=$OLD_NAME
    if [ "$RENAMED" -eq 1 ]; then current=$NEW_NAME; fi
    if [ "$(state "$current")" = Running ]; then
        call_incus stop_instance "$(payload --arg name "$current" '{name:$name,force:true}')" || true
        wait_state "$current" Stopped 60 || true
    fi
    unset_config "$current" raw.lxc || true
    for device in opdbus-netmaker-runtime opdbus-netmaker-adapter opdbus-netmaker-sv opdbus-netmaker-runit-etc opdbus-netmaker-runit-root; do
        remove_device "$current" "$device"
    done
    set_config "$current" boot.autostart true || true
    if [ "$RENAMED" -eq 1 ]; then
        call_incus rename_instance "$(payload --arg name "$NEW_NAME" --arg new_name "$OLD_NAME" \
            '{name:$name,new_name:$new_name}')" || true
        RENAMED=0
    fi
    call_incus restore_snapshot "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg snapshot "$SNAPSHOT" \
        '{name:$name,snapshot_name:$snapshot}')" || true
    if [ -f "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" ]; then
        install -m 0755 "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run
    fi
    call_incus start_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" '{name:$name}')" || true
    wait_state "$OLD_NAME" Running 120 || true
    sv down incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    log 'rollback attempted; inspect Incus state and baseline before retrying'
}

finish() {
    rc=$?
    if [ "$SUCCESS" -ne 1 ]; then rollback; fi
    exit "$rc"
}
trap finish EXIT HUP INT TERM

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || die 'must run as root'
[ -S "$SOCKET" ] || die "missing Incus socket $SOCKET"
[ -S /run/opdbus/session-bus.sock ] || die 'missing opdbus session bus'
[ "$(state "$OLD_NAME")" = Running ] || die "$OLD_NAME is not Running"
[ "$(state "$NEW_NAME")" = Missing ] || die "$NEW_NAME already exists"
for path in \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/runit" \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit/1" \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" \
    "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run"; do
    [ -e "$path" ] || die "missing golden artifact $path"
done

OLD_PID=$(pid_of "$OLD_NAME")
[ "$OLD_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'old container has no init PID'
LISTEN_PORT=$(jq -r '.listenport // 0' "/proc/$OLD_PID/root/etc/netclient/netclient.json")
case "$LISTEN_PORT" in ''|0|*[!0-9]*) die 'no captured netclient listen port' ;; esac
BASELINE_HTTP=$(curl --silent --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/server/health || true)
[ "$BASELINE_HTTP" != 000 ] || die 'baseline Netmaker API listener is unreachable'
install -d -m 0755 /etc/default
printf 'NETMK_PEER_PORTS=%s\n' "$LISTEN_PORT" | install -m 0644 /dev/stdin "$ENV_OUT"
install -d -m 0770 "$RUNTIME_DIR"
if [ ! -f "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before" ]; then
    install -m 0600 /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run "$BASELINE_DIR/incus-ct-netmaker.run.before"
fi
printf '%s\n' "$SNAPSHOT" >"$BASELINE_DIR/runit-migration-snapshot"

log "creating rollback snapshot $OLD_NAME/$SNAPSHOT"
call_incus snapshot_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg snapshot "$SNAPSHOT" \
    '{name:$name,snapshot_name:$snapshot}')"

log 'holding the legacy host supervisor down during rename'
sv down incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
log "stopping $OLD_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus stop_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" '{name:$name,force:false}')"
MUTATED=1
wait_state "$OLD_NAME" Stopped 120 || die "$OLD_NAME did not stop"

log "renaming $OLD_NAME to $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus rename_instance "$(payload --arg name "$OLD_NAME" --arg new_name "$NEW_NAME" \
    '{name:$name,new_name:$new_name}')"
RENAMED=1
[ "$(state "$NEW_NAME")" = Stopped ] || die 'renamed instance is not Stopped'

log 'attaching immutable golden runit artifacts and writable runtime directory'
set_config "$NEW_NAME" boot.autostart false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-root \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit" /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runit-etc \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/etc/runit" /etc/runit true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-sv \
    "$GOLDEN/containers/netmaker-runit/bin/sv" /usr/bin/sv true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-adapter \
    "$GOLDEN/bin/op-grpc-adapters" /usr/bin/op-grpc-adapters true false
add_disk "$NEW_NAME" opdbus-netmaker-runtime \
    "$RUNTIME_DIR" /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker false true
set_config "$NEW_NAME" raw.lxc 'lxc.init.cmd = /opt/opdbus-netmaker-runit/bin/runit'

install -m 0755 "$GOLDEN/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run" /etc/runit/sv/incus-ct-netmaker/run
log "starting $NEW_NAME through audited D-Bus"
call_incus start_instance "$(payload --arg name "$NEW_NAME" '{name:$name}')"
wait_state "$NEW_NAME" Running 120 || die "$NEW_NAME did not start"
NEW_PID=$(pid_of "$NEW_NAME")
[ "$NEW_PID" -gt 0 ] || die 'new container has no init PID'
INIT=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -m -p -- ps -p 1 -o comm= | tr -d ' ')
[ "$INIT" = runit ] || die "PID 1 is '$INIT', expected runit"

log 'waiting for preserved service listeners'
waited=0
while :; do
    listeners=$(nsenter -t "$NEW_PID" -n -- ss -lntH 2>/dev/null || true)
    ready=1
    for port in 8081 8083 1883 3000 9090 9100; do
        printf '%s\n' "$listeners" | grep -Eq "[:.]$port[[:space:]]" || ready=0
    done
    [ "$ready" -eq 1 ] && break
    [ "$waited" -lt 180 ] || die 'preserved service listeners did not recover'
    sleep 2
    waited=$((waited + 2))
done
CURRENT_HTTP=$(curl --silent --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/server/health || true)
[ "$CURRENT_HTTP" = "$BASELINE_HTTP" ] ||
    die "Netmaker API baseline changed ($BASELINE_HTTP -> $CURRENT_HTTP)"

sv up incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null
sleep 2
sv check incus-ct-netmaker >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$NEW_PID" >"$BASELINE_DIR/runit-migration-new-pid"
SUCCESS=1
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
log "$NEW_NAME is running with runit PID 1; baseline HTTP status $CURRENT_HTTP preserved"

#!/bin/sh
# build-golden.sh — publish a release two ways, from one build.
#
#   1. GOLDEN  — populate the `golden` btrfs subvolume: the deployable content.
#                Taking the read-only snapshot and running `btrfs send` belongs
#                to the deployment process, not here. This script only makes
#                `golden` correct and current.
#   2. LIVE    — install the same binaries into this host's runtime
#                (/usr/local/bin, /etc/runit/sv) and restart only the runit
#                services whose binary actually changed.
#
# Both read the same `target/release`, so the golden subvolume and the running
# host are provably the same build — the MANIFEST records per-binary sha256 so
# that can be checked after the fact.
#
# Layout created under $OPDBUS_ROOT (default /opt/op-dbus):
#
#   golden/                      the deployable subvolume
#     bin/                       release binaries
#     sbin/                      control scripts + systemd compat layer
#     sv/<service>/run           runit service definitions
#     etc/                       environment defaults, pacman hooks
#     MANIFEST                   commit, build time, sha256 per binary
#
# Usage:
#   build-golden.sh                 # both paths (default)
#   build-golden.sh --golden-only   # skip touching the running host
#   build-golden.sh --live-only     # skip the subvolume
#   build-golden.sh --no-restart    # install live but leave services running old code
#   build-golden.sh --dry-run
#
# Requires root for the subvolume and the live install. Never builds: run
# `CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release` first (the
# vendored RocksDB in cozorocks needs that flag on modern GCC).
set -eu

OPDBUS_ROOT=${OPDBUS_ROOT:-/opt/op-dbus}
GOLDEN_DIR="$OPDBUS_ROOT/golden"

INSTALL_BIN=${INSTALL_BIN:-/usr/local/bin}
INSTALL_SBIN=${INSTALL_SBIN:-/usr/local/sbin}
RUNIT_SV_DIR=${RUNIT_SV_DIR:-/etc/runit/sv}
RUNIT_RUNSVDIR=${RUNIT_RUNSVDIR:-/etc/runit/runsvdir/default}

DO_GOLDEN=1
DO_LIVE=1
DO_RESTART=1
DRY_RUN=0

SCRIPT_PATH=$(readlink -f "$0" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$0")
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$SCRIPT_PATH")" && pwd)
if [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../Cargo.toml" ]; then
    PROJECT_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
else
    PROJECT_ROOT=${OP_DBUS_ROOT:-$(pwd)}
fi
RELEASE_DIR=${RELEASE_DIR:-"$PROJECT_ROOT/target/release"}

log()  { printf '\033[0;34m[golden]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
ok()   { printf '\033[0;32m[ ok  ]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[warn ]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '\033[0;31m[fail ]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

run() {
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
        printf '  would run: %s\n' "$*"
    else
        "$@"
    fi
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --golden-only) DO_LIVE=0 ;;
        --live-only)   DO_GOLDEN=0 ;;
        --no-restart)  DO_RESTART=0 ;;
        --dry-run)     DRY_RUN=1 ;;
        -h|--help)     sed -n '2,35p' "$SCRIPT_PATH"; exit 0 ;;
        *)             die "unknown option: $1" ;;
    esac
    shift
done

# ── Preconditions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[ -d "$RELEASE_DIR" ] || die "no $RELEASE_DIR — build first:
  CXXFLAGS=\"-include cstdint\" cargo build --workspace --release"

BINARIES=$(find "$RELEASE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable ! -name '*.d' ! -name '*.so' | sort)
[ -n "$BINARIES" ] || die "$RELEASE_DIR contains no executables"
BIN_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | wc -l)
log "$BIN_COUNT release binaries in $RELEASE_DIR"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ] && [ "$(id -u)" != 0 ]; then
    die "must run as root (subvolume creation and install to $INSTALL_BIN)"
fi

COMMIT=$(git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
STAMP=$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

# ═══ Path 1: golden subvolume ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
build_golden() {
    log "building golden subvolume at $GOLDEN_DIR"

    # /opt must be btrfs for subvolumes; refuse rather than silently making a
    # plain directory that cannot be snapshotted or sent.
    fstype=$(stat -f -c %T "$OPDBUS_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || stat -f -c %T "$(dirname "$OPDBUS_ROOT")")
    case "$fstype" in
        btrfs) ;;
        *) die "$OPDBUS_ROOT is on '$fstype', not btrfs — snapshots and send need btrfs" ;;
    esac

    run mkdir -p "$OPDBUS_ROOT"

    if [ ! -d "$GOLDEN_DIR" ]; then
        run btrfs subvolume create "$GOLDEN_DIR"
        ok "created subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    else
        log "reusing existing subvolume $GOLDEN_DIR"
    fi

    run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv" "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc"

    # Binaries
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$GOLDEN_DIR/bin/$(basename "$bin")"
    done
    ok "staged $BIN_COUNT binaries into golden/bin"

    # Control scripts + the systemd compatibility layer.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units systemctl-shim \
                  migrate-netmaker-to-runit.sh build-golden.sh; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/sbin/agent-runit-guard.sh"
    ok "staged control scripts into golden/sbin"

    # Runit service definitions tracked in the repo.
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        run mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc"
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/log/run"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}finish" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}finish" "$GOLDEN_DIR/sv/$svc/finish"
    done
    ok "staged runit service definitions into golden/sv"

    # NetMaker container runit root. The tree is mounted read-only into the
    # container; stage 1 materializes writable supervise directories under
    # /run. Runit itself is captured from this runit host so the golden release
    # contains every executable needed before the container starts.
    container_src="$PROJECT_ROOT/deploy/containers/netmaker-runit"
    container_dst="$GOLDEN_DIR/containers/netmaker-runit"
    [ -d "$container_src/etc/runit/sv" ] ||
        die "missing NetMaker runit tree at $container_src"
    run rm -rf "$container_dst"
    run mkdir -p "$container_dst/bin" "$container_dst/etc/runit"
    for tool in runit runsvdir runsv sv chpst; do
        [ -x "/usr/bin/$tool" ] || die "missing host runit executable /usr/bin/$tool"
        run install -Dm755 "/usr/bin/$tool" "$container_dst/bin/$tool"
    done
    find "$container_src/etc/runit" -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r source; do
        relative=${source#"$container_src/"}
        case "$relative" in
            etc/runit/1|etc/runit/2|etc/runit/3|*/run|*/finish) mode=755 ;;
            *) mode=644 ;;
        esac
        run install -Dm"$mode" "$source" "$container_dst/$relative"
    done
    ok "staged NetMaker runit PID-1 tree into golden/containers"

    # Config the target needs alongside the binaries.
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../environment.default" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/environment.default"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" ] &&
        run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../99-agent-runit-guard.hook" \
            "$GOLDEN_DIR/etc/pacman-hooks/99-agent-runit-guard.hook"

    # MANIFEST: what this snapshot is, and the hashes to prove the running host
    # matches it.
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
        {
            printf 'golden-build: %s\n' "$STAMP"
            printf 'commit: %s\n' "$COMMIT"
            printf 'source: %s\n' "$PROJECT_ROOT"
            printf 'init: runit (sv)\n'
            printf 'binaries: %s\n' "$BIN_COUNT"
            printf '\n[sha256]\n'
            printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
                printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "$bin" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(basename "$bin")"
            done
        } > "$GOLDEN_DIR/MANIFEST"
    fi
    ok "wrote golden/MANIFEST (commit $COMMIT)"
    log "golden is ready; the read-only snapshot and btrfs send happen at deploy time"
}

# ═══ Path 2: live runtime ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Services that are never auto-restarted: they carry the host's network and
# session bus, and bouncing them from a deploy script can cut remote access or
# reparent the control plane. They are reported so an operator can restart them
# deliberately, on the console, in a chosen order.
NEVER_AUTO_RESTART="ovs-vswitchd ovsbr0-addr ovsbr0-svc-addr ovsbr0-uplink \
uplink-dhcp op-session-bus opdbus-rundirs dbus"

# Which enabled services actually exec a given binary?
#
# Matches the installed path with a trailing word boundary, not the bare name:
# a substring match would tie `opdbus` to `opdbus-rundirs` and drag unrelated
# services into the restart set.
services_using() {
    binary=$1
    # `.` is the only ERE metacharacter in these paths.
    escaped=$(printf '%s' "$INSTALL_BIN/$binary" | sed 's/\./\\./g')
    for link in "$RUNIT_RUNSVDIR"/*; do
        [ -e "$link" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$link")
        run_script="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        [ -f "$run_script" ] || continue
        if grep -qE "${escaped}([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|\$)" "$run_script" 2>/dev/null; then
            printf '%s\n' "$svc"
        fi
    done
}

install_live() {
    log "installing into the live runtime"

    changed_binaries=""
    printf '%s\n' "$BINARIES" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
        name=$(basename "$bin")
        target="$INSTALL_BIN/$name"
        if [ -f "$target" ] && cmp -s "$bin" "$target"; then
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "$bin" "$target"
        printf '%s\n' "$name" >> /tmp/golden-changed.$$
    done
    [ -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$" ] && changed_binaries=$(cat "/tmp/golden-changed.$$")
    rm -f "/tmp/golden-changed.$$"

    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        ok "all $BIN_COUNT binaries already current in $INSTALL_BIN"
    else
        ok "updated $(printf '%s\n' "$changed_binaries" | wc -l) binaries in $INSTALL_BIN"
    fi

    # Control scripts. The systemctl shim goes in $INSTALL_BIN because sudo's
    # secure_path searches it before /usr/bin, so it wins for installers.
    for script in systemd-unit-to-runit op-convert-systemd-units; do
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/$script" "$INSTALL_SBIN/$script"
    done
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/systemctl-shim" "$INSTALL_BIN/systemctl"
    [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" ] &&
        run install -Dm755 "$SCRIPT_DIR/../agent-runit-guard.sh" \
            "$INSTALL_SBIN/agent-runit-guard"
    ok "installed control scripts + systemd compat layer"

    if [ -d /etc/pacman.d/hooks ] || mkdir -p /etc/pacman.d/hooks 2>/dev/null; then
        [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" ] &&
            run install -Dm644 "$SCRIPT_DIR/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook" \
                /etc/pacman.d/hooks/99-systemd-unit-to-runit.hook
    fi

    # Service definitions: install new ones, never clobber a hand-tuned run
    # script that differs (the host copy is authoritative until an operator says
    # otherwise).
    for svc_dir in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/*/; do
        [ -f "${svc_dir}run" ] || continue
        svc=$(basename "$svc_dir")
        dest="$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/run"
        if [ -f "$dest" ] && ! cmp -s "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"; then
            warn "$dest differs from the repo copy — leaving the host version alone"
            continue
        fi
        run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}run" "$dest"
        [ -f "${svc_dir}log/run" ] &&
            run install -Dm755 "${svc_dir}log/run" "$RUNIT_SV_DIR/$svc/log/run"
    done

    if [ "$DO_RESTART" != 1 ]; then
        warn "--no-restart: services still running the previous binaries"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ -z "$changed_binaries" ]; then
        log "nothing changed; no restarts needed"
        return 0
    fi
